fixedOrder: old ref invalid/new ref byte exact

semanticAcceptance.initial: At least one active conflict connects A/B schedule claims; both endpoints disputed. C has claims and no same/conflict/revision/uncertain cross-event link to A/B.
semanticAcceptance.search: Text search for M-17 returns knowledge closure including both endpoints of the A/B conflict.
semanticAcceptance.revision: At least one active world-change revision links an A/B schedule claim to D; its left is superseded and right supported. Each initial conflict is now inactive. This does not require every A/B identity, location, or historical-original-plan claim to be superseded.
semanticAcceptance.revokeD: D absent, each original A/B conflict active again and both endpoints disputed or unresolved.
semanticAcceptance.revokeB: B and D claims, roots and relations absent from public knowledge.
semanticAcceptance.reinspectC: Same sourceId/mediaRef, revision increments by one, old SourceRef invalid, R2 bytes identical, actual image perception request includes exact original C bytes plus non-leading question; response preserves M-18 and 2026-11-06.
semanticAcceptance.nativeQuery: Original C image used without text query; top result references current C version, no revoked source or stale C version.

scoringPolicy: First outputs only. Stop at first failed API or semantic assertion. No retry, prompt/scoring repair, fallback, or inferred permission. Ground-truth metadata is never sent to any model.
